title: Japanese AI beating Mythos & Fable 5
description:
Sakana AI's Fugu takes a different approach to AI.

Instead of relying on a single model, it intelligently orchestrates multiple models behind the scenes, assigning different parts of a task to the models best suited for them before combining everything into one final answer.

The result is frontier-level performance without depending on a single frontier model.

This feels like the next evolution of AI, where coordination between models matters just as much as the models themselves.

#sakanaai #ai #llm #aiagents #opensource #genai
